'''Operation Clean Sweep''' was a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] operation carried out during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It saw the Republic [[Battle in the Thanium sector|prevent]] the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Rimark]] from selling the plans of the [[Void Anvil]] in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]], and also destroy [[Battle in the Baros system|wipe out]] [[Darth Ordrem]]'s forces in the [[Baros system/Legends|Baros system]].
